newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 15 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said it has qualified for bond insuarance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Iowa State Board of Regents, Iowa, $9.150 million revenue bonds.
--Schaumburg Township, Ill., $8.1 million library general obligation bonds.
--New Orleans, La., $30 million sewage service revenue bonds.
--Dighton Regional School District, Mass., $3.8 million GOs.
--University of North Carolina, Wilmington, N.C., $4.270 million refunding revenue bonds and $6.44 million revs.
--Hempstead Village, N.Y., $5.410 million various purpose bonds and $3.344 million various purpose bonds.
--Naples CSD, N.Y., $5.4 million school district GOs.
--Newberg, Oregon, $384,000 limited tax bonds and $2.950 million GOs.
--Snohomish County, Wash., $1.310 million limited tax bonds and $39.185 million limited tax bonds.
